context_after: // JADE-FLAG:JDBC_ODBC_BRIDGE_REMOVED sun.jdbc.odbc.JdbcOdbcDriver (the JDBC-ODBC Bridge) is removed from the JDK as of Java SE 8; Class.forName on this name throws ClassNotFoundException. 0.9

patterns.reason: sun.jdbc.odbc.JdbcOdbcDriver (the JDBC-ODBC Bridge) is removed from the JDK as of Java SE 8; Class.forName on this name throws ClassNotFoundException.

rule_description: Starting with JDK 8, the JDBC-ODBC Bridge (sun.jdbc.odbc.JdbcOdbcDriver) is no longer included with the JDK. It was always a transitional, unsupported product bundled with select JDKs, never the JRE. Code that names this driver class must switch to a vendor-supplied or commercial JDBC driver -- there is no drop-in replacement class.
rule_name: JDBC-ODBC Bridge removed from the JDK
verification_hint: No mechanical rewrite exists -- there is no bridge-equivalent driver class. Verify the default driver string is no longer 'sun.jdbc.odbc.JdbcOdbcDriver' and that DBKB callers are documented as needing an explicit setDriver()/constructor-supplied JDBC driver before running on Java 8.
